ModMetaData.name: Wraith & Nanite Gravtech
ModMetaData.author: Vardath
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial, non-commercial fan-made RimWorld 1.6 mod inspired by Stargate Atlantis and SG-1 themes. WNG's core gameplay is independent of third-party Stargate mods.
Requires the complete RimWorld DLC set for 1.6: Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly and Odyssey. WNG does not need to force every subsystem to use every DLC, but the full content set is an explicit dependency so the rebuild may use the most appropriate native RimWorld mechanic when it improves a feature.
CatCraft's Stargates!, ONAC and RimGate - Jaffa, Kree! (Biotech) remain optional: when present WNG can add compatible Stargate raid/travel behavior, faction interoperability and additional craft such as Jaffa/Goa'uld Al'kesh transport and Ha'tak gravship content without duplicating or taking ownership of those mods' Stargate, Goa'uld, Tok'ra or Jaffa systems.
WNG uses dependency-free optional integration surfaces for those third-party mods and must continue loading and functioning when they are absent.
